Bixby to his family, dated November 13 through December 13, 1937, with handwritten note at end from Debby Bixby to her mother; includes reports from Nanking [Nanjing], Hankow [Hankou], CNAC meetings, journey from Hankou to Hong Kong, and observations of the war; mentions [Ernest] Allison, [William L.] Bond, Harry Smith, Julius and Mrs. Barr, Dr. [Francis] and Mrs. Pan, Mr. Peck, Mr. Johnson.
